title: Define no-maintainer-script activation rule
purpose: Prevent AgentOS artifacts from copying traditional package maintainer-script authority.
scope: Define how package manager adapters differ from artifact activation.
acceptance_criteria: Artifact manifests cannot define arbitrary shell hooks.
Activation operations are typed and policy-evaluated.
Package manager adapter workflow remains isolated and approval-gated.
failure_modes: Package adapter is treated as trusted maintainer script.
